name: Kicker + action title + lede
definition: Small chapter label, then a full-sentence takeaway title, then one or two supporting lines.
bestUse: Every content slide; the title carries the argument.

demo.how: The kicker names the chapter in small type, the title states the takeaway as a full sentence, and the lede adds one supporting line. Play builds the three layers in that order, with margin tags naming each, then adds the chart that proves the title.
